name: Beef Stew
summary: Browned beef simmered slowly with root vegetables, after Fannie Farmer's 1896 method.
ingredients: 3 lb beef from the lower round, cut in 1 inch cubes

equipment.help: A stew wants a bare simmer, and every hob holds one differently.
equipment.label: Hob

steps.title: Cut the beef
steps.body: Trim the beef and cut it into cubes about an inch across.

steps.title: Dredge it
steps.body: Toss the cubes in the flour with the salt and pepper until every piece is dusted.

steps.title: Brown the meat
steps.body: Heat the fat in a heavy pot and brown the beef a few pieces at a time. A crowded pot steams instead of browning.
steps.note: The brown crust is where the colour and most of the flavour of the stew comes from.

steps.title: Add the water
steps.body: Pour in the boiling water and scrape the bottom of the pot clean.

steps.title: Set a gas burner to its lowest flame
steps.body: Gas responds at once. If it still bubbles hard, rest the pot on a simmer plate.

steps.title: Set an electric hob to low and wait
steps.body: The plate holds heat, so it keeps rising for a minute or two after you turn it down.

steps.title: Set induction to a low simmer
steps.body: Induction changes instantly and can hold a true simmer. Use a low number rather than a boost setting.

steps.title: Simmer the beef
steps.body: Cover and simmer until the beef is tender. Keep it just trembling, never at a rolling boil.

steps.title: Add the vegetables
steps.body: Put in the onion, carrot and turnip. Add the potatoes twenty minutes later so they do not fall apart.

steps.title: Season and serve
steps.body: Taste for salt and pepper. Serve very hot in deep plates.
